playerSpeed.name: Run speed
playerSpeed.description: How fast the archer runs, in tiles per second.

jumpHeight.name: Jump height
jumpHeight.description: Peak height of a full jump, in tiles. The world is built for about 3.5.

airFocusSlow.name: Air Focus speed
airFocusSlow.description: How slow the world runs while aiming in mid-air. 1 turns Air Focus off.

arrowSpeed.name: Arrow speed
arrowSpeed.description: Launch speed of a full draw. Quick shots fly a little slower.

footingMax.name: Steps at once
footingMax.description: How many Footing steps can stand at the same time before the oldest fades.

energyRegen.name: Energy recovery
energyRegen.description: Footing energy recovered per second while standing on natural ground.

windStrength.name: Wind strength
windStrength.description: How hard the gusts lift the archer.

bossHp.name: Stag health
bossHp.description: Hits on the forehead rune needed to topple the Tower Stag.

sfxVolume.name: Effects volume
sfxVolume.description: Volume of arrows, steps and creatures.

showHitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
showHitboxes.description: Outlines the archer, enemies and standing surfaces.
